verdict.rationale: Productboard is a product-management platform, so an embeddable changelog widget for announcing updates is a fair axis to ask about. However, nothing in the evidence documents a changelog, release-notes widget, or embeddable announcement component. The REST API, webhooks, MCP server and in-app plugin extensions are developer building blocks or adjacent features, and none of them is the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can showcase new updates within my product using an embeddable changelog widget
